id: 28_Fire Safety Quiz Test Your Basic Fire Safety Knowledge Fire Safety Quiz Fire MCQ
title: 消防小测验：十分钟八题过关（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/28_Fire Safety Quiz Test Your Basic Fire Safety Knowledge Fire Safety Quiz Fire MCQ.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/28_Fire Safety Quiz Test Your Basic Fire Safety Knowledge Fire Safety Quiz Fire MCQ（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
points.S1: 加热不离人，过夜要审批
points.S2: 大功率设备用专用插座

shots.scene: 欣欣举着计时器，旁边是一张空白答卷
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a timer next to a blank answer sheet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 十分钟，十道消防题，你能过关吗？
overlay: 消防小测验：十分钟八题过关

shots.scene: 阿杰看着屏幕上的空白成绩页，垂头丧气
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps in front of a laptop showing a blank score page with a red cross icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手点答案，只得了三成。

shots.scene: 小研拉过椅子坐在他旁边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls up a chair and sits beside him with a notebook.
shots.narration: 小研说：别乱点，我们一题题弄懂。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 空白测验框：十个进度格和一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz panel with ten progress segments and a countdown timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 十道题，限时十分钟。
overlay: 测验规则：十题八对才过关

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 进度条走到八格，亮起绿灯
shots.prompt_en: The progress bar fills eight of ten segments and a green light turns on. No people.
shots.narration: 答对八题，才算通过。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 返回键和重做键图标
shots.prompt_en: Two button icons: a back arrow and a circular restart arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 可以返回修改，交卷后看对错再重做。

shots.scene: 灶台上锅在煮，人走开的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pot on a stove with an icon of a person walking away crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 先看防火要点：做饭别走开。

shots.scene: 易燃物从灶台边挪开，旁边一个定时器
shots.prompt_en: Paper towels and a cloth are moved away from the stove; a kitchen timer sits beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃物远离灶台，用定时器提醒。

shots.scene: 一排图标：火源、放大镜、灭火器、出口
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a flame, a magnifier, a fire extinguisher and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 认原因、找隐患、选对灭火器、会疏散。

shots.scene: 一个插座插满插头，冒出热气
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket overloaded with many plugs, heat lines rising from it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：怎么防插座过载起火？

shots.scene: 插满插头和延长线分担的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a crowded socket and a chain of extension cords. No people.
shots.narration: 别插满，也别靠插线板分担。

shots.scene: 一个插座只插一台电热水壶
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket with a single plug from an electric kettle. No people.
shots.narration: 一个插座，只插一台大功率电器。

shots.scene: 炒锅里的油着火
shots.prompt_en: A frying pan on a stove with burning oil flames. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：油锅起火用什么灭？

shots.scene: 水杯泼向油锅的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cup of water thrown at a burning pan is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万不能泼水，会溅起大火。

shots.scene: 关火，盖上锅盖或灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns off the stove knob and covers the pan with a fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 先关火，盖锅盖或灭火毯。

shots.scene: 王老师指着国内火灾分类表上的F
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank chart with six classes, the last one highlighted.
shots.narration: 国内把油锅火单列为F类。

shots.scene: 汽油桶和油瓶旁的火焰
shots.prompt_en: A closed fuel can and an oil bottle beside a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：易燃液体着火是哪类？

shots.scene: B 类卡片被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A class card for liquids, with a droplet and flame icon, is circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 汽油、溶剂这类液体火是B类。

shots.scene: 老李用测试杆测天花板上的探测器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a long test pole to check a ceiling smoke detector.
shots.narration: 第四题：感烟探测器要测试吗？

shots.scene: 日历上画了圈
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with recurring circled dates and a check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要定期测试，周期按规定来。

shots.scene: 小研发现探测器灯不亮，向老李报修
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notices a detector light is off and reports it to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 发现指示灯异常，马上报修。

shots.scene: 一块金属着火，冒出白光
shots.prompt_en: A small piece of metal burning with a bright white flame on a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：镁、钾等金属着火是哪类？

shots.scene: D 类卡片被圈出，水滴图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A metal class card is circled in green; a water droplet icon beside it is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: D类金属火，不能用水。

shots.scene: 一桶干砂和专用灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A bucket of dry sand and a special extinguisher with a metal pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 用干砂或专用灭火剂。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：维护工具、破电线、燃着的蜡烛
shots.prompt_en: Three icon cards: a maintenance wrench, a frayed wire and a burning candle. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：哪项不是常见火灾原因？

shots.scene: 维护工具卡片被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The maintenance wrench card is circled in green; the other two glow red. No people.
shots.narration: 定期维护不是原因，是防火的办法。

shots.scene: 破电线和蜡烛图标亮红灯
shots.prompt_en: The frayed wire and candle icons flash with red warning lights. No people.
shots.narration: 线路故障、无人看管的明火才是。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过关
shots.scene: 阿杰重新答题，进度条全绿
shots.prompt_en: The young male student retakes the quiz on a laptop; the progress bar turns fully green.
shots.narration: 阿杰弄懂再答，这回过关了。

shots.section_title: 加热不离人，过夜要审批
shots.scene: 实验室加热板上的烧瓶，旁边没人
shots.prompt_en: A flask on a hot plate in a laboratory with nobody around. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室加热，跟做饭一样不能离人。
overlay: 加热不离人，过夜要审批

shots.section_title: 加热不离人，过夜要审批
shots.scene: 阿杰离开前关掉加热板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the hot plate before leaving the bench.
shots.narration: 离开就关加热，不让设备空烧。

shots.section_title: 加热不离人，过夜要审批
shots.scene: 老周在空白审批表上签字，门上挂标识牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank approval form and hangs a blank notice card on the lab door.
shots.narration: 必须过夜运行的，先审批、挂标识。

shots.section_title: 加热不离人，过夜要审批
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员夜间巡查
shots.prompt_en: The security officer patrols the laboratory corridor at night with a flashlight.
shots.narration: 写清联系人，便于巡查发现问题。

shots.section_title: 大功率设备用专用插座
shots.scene: 烘箱插在插线板上，插线板放在地上
shots.prompt_en: A drying oven plugged into a power strip lying on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 烘箱、马弗炉功率大。
overlay: 大功率设备用专用插座

shots.section_title: 大功率设备用专用插座
shots.scene: 插线板图标打叉，烘箱改插墙上专用插座
shots.prompt_en: The power strip is crossed out; the oven is now plugged into a dedicated wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 要用专用插座，不接插线板。

shots.section_title: 大功率设备用专用插座
shots.scene: 老李检查插头和电线有无发热
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the plug and cable for heat with the back of his hand.
shots.narration: 插头发热、电线破损，停用报修。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜前弯腰探身，头伸进柜口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leans forward at a fume hood with her head inside the sash opening.
shots.narration: 通风柜前探头弯腰，既不安全也累。

shots.scene: 小研坐上合适高度的椅子，头在柜外，手臂放松
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits on a chair of proper height, head outside the sash, forearms relaxed.
shots.narration: 头留在柜外，调好椅子高度。

shots.scene: 常用物品放在柜内伸手可及处
shots.prompt_en: Frequently used items placed within easy reach just inside the fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 常用物品放在顺手的位置。

shots.scene: 小研站起来活动肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands up and stretches her shoulders.
shots.narration: 隔一会儿起身活动。

shots.scene: 一排图标：插座、油锅盖、B、D、维护工具
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a single plug socket, a pan lid, a liquid class card, a metal class card and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 插座不过载，油锅不泼水，分清火的种类。

shots.scene: 阿杰关掉加热板，烘箱插在专用插座
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off a hot plate; an oven is plugged into a wall socket nearby.
shots.narration: 加热不离人，大功率用专用插座。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起绿色对勾挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a green checkmark and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 弄懂原因再答题，消防知识记得牢！
